title: Sung Tieu
bio: Sung Tieu (b. 1987, Hai Duong, Vietnam) is a Berlin-basedartist whose multidisciplinary practice spans installation,sculpture, drawing, text, sound, and video. Her workinvestigates the psychological dimensions of power,exploring how bureaucratic and institutional systems shapesubjectivity.Her current solo exhibitions includeRuin, the GermanPavilion at the 61st International Art Exhibition of La Biennaledi Venezia;Inserzioniat Castello di Rivoli, Turin; andHow isyour day?at Emalin, London. Current group exhibitionsinclude the 82nd edition of the Whitney Biennial, New York;Boros Collection #5at Boros, Berlin;A Thousand TimesBerlin,The Collection Hamburger Bahnhof – Nationalgalerieder Gegenwart, Berlin; andAsad Raza: Electricityat E-WERKLuckenwalde.Tieu’s work has been exhibited internationally, withpresentations at Kunsthalle Bern, KW Institute forContemporary Art (Berlin), Harvard Art Museums, Amant(New York), Mudam Luxembourg, MIT List Visual Arts Center(Cambridge), Lafayette Anticipations (Paris), Kunst MuseumWinterthur, Jameel Arts Centre (Dubai), Haus der Kulturender Welt (Berlin), Nottingham Contemporary, and Haus derKunst (Munich). She has also participated in major biennials,including the14th Taipei Biennial(2025),15th GwangjuBiennale(2024),14th Shanghai Biennale(2023),34th Bienalde São Paulo(2021), and the4th Kyiv Biennial (2021).
